parameters.name: ComputingResourceProvider
parameters.description: The provider of the compute resources.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `desc`: descending.

- `asc`: ascending.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- `ECS`: ECS.

- `Lingjun`: Lingjun intelligent computing resources.

parameters.name: ShowAll
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return all results.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Valid values include: `DisplayName`, `GmtCreated`, `GmtModified`, `RegionID`, `Duration`, `PricingCycle`, and `PayType`.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the resource group.
